Playbook for running Claude Code and Cursor in Docker on a Mac, plus the project template those containers copy in.

## Start here
- [README.md](README.md) — Mac setup, Case 1/2/3 workflows, RTK + Headroom, troubleshooting.
- [secure-agent-playbook.sh](secure-agent-playbook.sh) — one-time install: copies the template, builds Case 1 image, writes `new-project` / `claude-box`.
- [secure-agent-template/](secure-agent-template/) — files `new-project` copies into every new repo.
- [docker-cheat-sheet.md](docker-cheat-sheet.md) — image vs container vs volume for this playbook.

## /
Audience is Apple Silicon + zsh. Edit the template, not `~/.config/secure-agent-template/`, then re-run the setup script.

- [README.md](README.md) — end-user guide; start here for install and daily commands.
- [secure-agent-playbook.sh](secure-agent-playbook.sh) — host installer; Case 1 Dockerfile (RTK + Headroom) and zsh helpers live in this script.
- [docker-cheat-sheet.md](docker-cheat-sheet.md) — Docker primer mapped onto `claude-box` and Dev Containers.
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) — project standards for agents working on this playbook repo.
- [.gitignore](.gitignore) — Python-oriented ignore plus Claude/Headroom session files.
- [secure-agent-template/](secure-agent-template/) — see its section below.
- [docs/](docs/) — see its section below.

## docs/
Agent index of this repo. Refresh after moves/adds/deletes.

- [repo-map.md](docs/repo-map.md) — this file.

## secure-agent-template/
Source tree copied to `~/.config/secure-agent-template/` and into each `new-project`. Change defaults here.

- [CLAUDE.md](secure-agent-template/CLAUDE.md) — standards pasted into every new project.
- [notes.md](secure-agent-template/notes.md) — workspace theme, git credential helper, RTK and Headroom how-to.
- [.gitignore](secure-agent-template/.gitignore) — secrets, build output, Claude local/Headroom wrap files.
- [.claudeignore](secure-agent-template/.claudeignore) — advisory skip list for Claude context.
- [.cursorignore](secure-agent-template/.cursorignore) — Cursor indexing skip list.

## secure-agent-template/.claude/
Claude Code project config shipped to new repos.

- [settings.json](secure-agent-template/.claude/settings.json) — `permissions.deny`, status line, `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` for Headroom.
- [statusline.sh](secure-agent-template/.claude/statusline.sh) — context % / model / rate-limit bar; needs `jq`.
- [skills/folder-explore/SKILL.md](secure-agent-template/.claude/skills/folder-explore/SKILL.md) — how to build or refresh `docs/repo-map.md`.

## secure-agent-template/.cursor/
Cursor project config shipped to new repos.

- [mcp.json](secure-agent-template/.cursor/mcp.json) — Headroom MCP (`compress` / `retrieve` / `stats`) via `/usr/local/bin/headroom`.
- [rules/global-standards.mdc](secure-agent-template/.cursor/rules/global-standards.mdc) — always-on typing, no hardcoded secrets, small diffs.

## secure-agent-template/.devcontainer/
Dev Container recipes for Cases 2 and 3. Case 1 ignores this folder.

- [devcontainer.json](secure-agent-template/.devcontainer/devcontainer.json) — both mode: Claude feature, Headroom env, `postCreate` + `postStart`.
- [devcontainer.cursor-only.json](secure-agent-template/.devcontainer/devcontainer.cursor-only.json) — Cursor-only: no Claude feature; still installs Headroom MCP + proxy.
- [setup-agent-tools.sh](secure-agent-template/.devcontainer/setup-agent-tools.sh) — idempotent install of jq, RTK, Headroom; routes Claude; starts proxy.
- [start-headroom.sh](secure-agent-template/.devcontainer/start-headroom.sh) — start `headroom proxy` on `127.0.0.1:8787` if unhealthy; beacon off.

## Dotfile config (this playbook repo)
Config for agents working *on* the playbook, not what `new-project` copies. `.devcontainer/` here mounts Docker socket and is not the template.

- [.claude/settings.json](.claude/settings.json) — playbook-repo Claude deny list and status line (no Headroom URL).
- [.claude/statusline.sh](.claude/statusline.sh) — same status-line script as the template.
- [.claude/skills/folder-explore/SKILL.md](.claude/skills/folder-explore/SKILL.md) — repo-map skill used in this repo.
- [.claudeignore](.claudeignore) — secrets and build output skipped from Claude auto-context.
- [.cursor/rules/global-standards.mdc](.cursor/rules/global-standards.mdc) — same engineering standards as the template.
- [.cursor/rules/local-trees.mdc](.cursor/rules/local-trees.mdc) — sibling honeynet/data trees are not this writing repo; do not publish them from here.
- [.cursorignore](.cursorignore) — Cursor indexing skip list for this repo.
- [.devcontainer/devcontainer.json](.devcontainer/devcontainer.json) — this sandbox: Claude volume + host Docker socket; not copied by `new-project`.
- [.devcontainer/devcontainer.cursor-only.json](.devcontainer/devcontainer.cursor-only.json) — unused sibling of the playbook sandbox recipe.

## Needs attention
- Existing projects already created with `new-project` do not pick up Headroom until you copy the updated template in and rebuild (Cases 2 & 3) or re-run `./secure-agent-playbook.sh` (Case 1).
